risk_summary: The disclosure presents severe liquidity and going-concern risk, including minimal operations, reliance on related-party advances, substantial unpaid management wages, and a stated substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern. The lessor repossessed leased equipment due to non-payment, while liabilities and accrued related-party obligations increased materially. Although many balances are quantified, extensive boilerplate, inconsistent wording, and incomplete text reduce clarity.
